relationship_to_restored_text: Interpretive contemplative layer aligned by verse. This does not replace the source-audited restored translation.

verses.mystical_translation: Military and royal leaders organize musicians whose instruments carry prophetic praise.
Asaph's sons serve under father and king.
Jeduthun and six sons turn lyre into thanksgiving.
Heman's fourteen sons are named as a musical household.
Three daughters are counted as gifts but left unnamed by the performance roster.
Family, temple, and king all shape the musicians' work.
Two hundred eighty-eight trained people are recognized as skilled.
Teacher and student, small and great, enter the same scheduling process.
Joseph and Gedaliah's groups receive the first courses.

contemplative_note: Music is called prophecy, yet it is also training, scheduling, family labor, and royal administration. Inspiration does not erase working conditions. Sacred sound remains sacred when artists can learn freely, women are not omitted, children are not coerced, and power cannot dictate every note.
